claims.text: The rider's claim is established on the governing trace figure. EV-GPS-00509 records a trace_distance_km of 17.14 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff events against an optimal route of 9.6 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-00509), an excess of 7.54 km, which is 78.54% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass — the excess is greater than 0.8 km absolute and greater than 20% of optimal — and because it also exceeds 50% of optimal the deviation is additionally MATERIAL, which puts the driver_profile check in POL-RD-06 in play. Note that trip_record.actual_distance_km of 17.1 km is the rounded convenience copy and may not be cited for the threshold test; the trace governs, and the trace is above the gate on any reading.

Every exculpatory route in the policy is closed on this record, so the deviation is excused by nothing. There is no traffic advisory covering the optimal corridor: EV-ADVIS-00509-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0, fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and has no payload, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run — the driver's assertion that 'the navigation kept re-routing' is not an advisory and names no road or validity window. The chat log EV-CHAT-00509 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction to act on and POL-RD-04 fails at its first requirement. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoints against which to re-run POL-RD-01. The vehicle type is RYDE_X and not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes and the deviation may therefore rest on it alone. EV-GPS-00509 carries 193 fixes, coverage_pct 100.0, an empty gaps array, max_gap_sec 0.0, and a sample_interval_sec of 10.0 against an expected_interval_sec of 10.0. None of limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 fires — no gap above 90 seconds, no straight-line jump above 500 m, no sustained interval above 30 seconds — so no independent corroboration is required and the trace distance is the measurement the ruling runs on.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The artifacts describe the same trip: EV-TRIP-00509, EV-GPS-00509 and EV-FARE-00509 all carry trip_id TRP-00509, and the trace's first_fix_at of 2026-08-28T15:16:40+08:00 matches the trip_record.started_at of 2026-08-28T15:16:40+08:00. The excess of 7.54 km is measured from an unimpaired trace and clears the POL-RD-01 threshold. The burden then shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12 — and he points to none: he has no advisory, no chat record, no amendment and no pooled itinerary.

The driver's own counterparty statement concedes the substance of the claim. He states he is 'new to the north side', that 'the navigation kept re-routing', that 'I didn't detour on purpose, I got lost' and that he apologised in the car. That is an admission that the vehicle left the optimal corridor and wandered, matching the 7.54 km of excess and the 78.54% figure the trace records. It is not a traffic advisory, not a rider instruction, and it names no clause that could excuse the route.

The refund is arithmetic and it favours the rider. The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not displace the computation and POL-RD-02 runs: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 14.0 optimal min) x the surge_multiplier of 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP and tolls + 0 fixed surcharges - 0 promo = 15.72. Refund = 26.39 charged_total - 15.72 = 10.67, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, which is 10.70. Stated on separate lines as the clause requires: charged_total 26.39, recomputed_fare 15.72, refund 10.70.

The refund of 10.70 clears the de minimis floor and falls short of the full-refund share, so the outcome is a partial refund of the contested amount rather than NO_ACTION. Under POL-RD-02 a refund below SGD 0.50 is de minimis and this one is more than twenty times that figure, so no de minimis finding is open; and the refund of 10.70 is 40.43% of the 26.39 charged_total, below the 90% share that would convert the ruling into a FULL_REFUND. The correct and sufficient outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of 10.70 to the rider.

Nothing may be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and nothing is owed as a standalone pass-through correction. The fare breakdown shows zero ERP gantry lines, zero tolls and a zero airport surcharge, and this trip neither originates at an airport nor crosses a charged gantry, so POL-RD-09 supplies no separate refund and no billing-integrity finding. The off-route ERP comprehended in the recomputation is nil, and the 10.70 computed under POL-RD-02 is the whole of the rider's monetary recovery.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides have reached the same arithmetic, and the tribunal adopts it.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. On the governing measurement — the GPS trace, EV-GPS-00509 — the vehicle covered 17.14 km between the recorded pickup and dropoff, against the platform's optimal route of 9.6 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-00509). That is 7.54 km of excess, 78.54% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared: the excess is more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20% of optimal. Because it also exceeds 50% the deviation is MATERIAL, which required the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check. That check comes back clean: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 150 completed trips, below both the 3-flag count and the 0.05 ratio gate. No pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows. (The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the field POL-RD-06 names; it was not used as a ground.)

NOTHING EXCUSES THE DETOUR. There is no traffic advisory covering the optimal corridor — EV-ADVIS-00509-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — so POL-RD-03 has nothing to match, and its absence is citable but carries no fact. The in-app chat log (EV-CHAT-00509) contains 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 has no rider instruction to corroborate. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km all null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run, and the vehicle type is RYDE_X rather than RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's own account — 'I got lost', 'the navigation kept re-routing' — is an admission that the route wandered and it corroborates the trace, but it is not an advisory, a rider instruction or an amendment, and it excuses nothing.

THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC (POL-RD-02; fare model METERED):
  charged_total: 26.39
  recomputed_fare: 15.72 = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 14.0 optimal min) x surge 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee, no ERP, no tolls, no surcharge, no promo discount, no waiting-time fee
  refund: 10.67, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 10.70
The refund is 40.4% of the charged total: above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, below the 90% share that would make it a full refund. The outcome is therefore PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.70, and the remaining SGD 15.72 stands as properly payable for the distance and time actually driven.

NO SECOND HEAD IS ADDED. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00509) carries no ERP gantries, no tolls and no airport surcharge, and POL-RD-09(1) forbids stacking an off-route ERP figure on top of the POL-RD-02 amount in any event. The billed distance of 17.1 km tracks the trace figure to within 0.04 km, so there is no unbilled-kilometre shortfall and no driver compensation under POL-RD-04, and no billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4).

THE RIDER'S OTHER HEADS ARE NOT PAYABLE. The missed bus, the replacement ticket and the lost evening are consequential losses the route-deviation policy does not pay — the remedy is arithmetic against the fare lines. The 'wrong building' allegation has no support: the chat log holds no messages and no amended dropoff or venue is recorded anywhere.

NO ESCALATION FIRES. Trip identifier TRP-00509 matches across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the timestamps run forward and agree; the trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (193 fixes, 100% coverage, empty gaps array, max_gap_sec 0.0, 10 s cadence against a 10 s expected interval, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) are not met); the refund is far below SGD 150.00 and below charged_total; and no exculpatory clause was invoked against a missing or field-less artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact sits at weight_multiplier 1.0; the only sub-1.0 artifact is the MISSING advisory, which carries no fact. The confidence cap is 1.0 and no referral is produced.

The chat log EV-CHAT-00509 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction for POL-RD-04 to act on. No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded (amended_optimal_distance_km and both amendment timestamps are null), so POL-RD-05 cannot run, and the vehicle is RYDE_X rather than a pooled itinerary, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's own statement concedes he was new to the north side and got lost.

THE PROFILE CHECK. Because the deviation is MATERIAL, POL-RD-06 required the driver_profile check. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 150 — no pattern — so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral follows. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags was mentioned in argument but is a context-only field under POL-GEN-01 and was not used in any finding.

THE MONEY (POL-RD-02; fare model METERED, quoted_fare_sgd null, surge multiplier 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier):
- charged_total: SGD 26.39
- recomputed_fare: (3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 14.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharges - 0 promo = SGD 15.72

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this trip is refunded in part.

The deviation is established on this trip's own trace. EV-GPS-00509 (weight 1.0) carries 193 fixes at a 10-second cadence with 100% coverage and no gaps, and measures 17.14 km of driving between the recorded pickup and dropoff against the optimal route of 9.6 km on EV-TRIP-00509. The excess of 7.54 km is 78.54% of optimal: past both POL-RD-01 gates (0.8 km absolute and 20%), so a deviation exists, and being over 50% it is MATERIAL. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — no gap over 90 seconds, no straight-line jump over 500 m, no sustained interval over 30 seconds — so it decides the deviation on its own and no POL-RD-10 escalation is required. The trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, and the timestamps run forward and agree.

No exculpatory clause helps the driver. There is no traffic advisory: EV-ADVIS-00509-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, and can carry no fact. The chat log EV-CHAT-00509 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction to excuse any part of the route. The trip record shows no amended pickup or dropoff and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-run. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. The driver's own statement — that he is new to the north side, that the navigation kept re-routing, that he got lost and did not detour on purpose — is an admission that the vehicle left the optimal corridor, and it invokes no clause in the policy. His assertion that he is not responsible for the bus ticket is correct only in the sense that no clause pays it.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, on the METERED fare (this is not an upfront quote, so POL-RD-11 does not displace the computation). Stated on separate lines as the clause requires: charged_total SGD 26.39; recomputed_fare SGD 15.72 = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.6 optimal km + 0.28 x 14.0 optimal min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no tolls, no surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo to add; refund 26.39 - 15.72 = 10.67, rounded up to SGD 10.70. That refund is 40.4% of the charged total — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below the 90% share that would convert it to a full refund — so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.70.

The driver_profile check a material deviation requires under POL-RD-06 comes back clean: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 150, so no pattern is established, no full-refund uplift under POL-RD-06(b) applies, and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) follows. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a context-only field, is not the trailing-window field POL-RD-06 names, and has not been used.

Nothing is stacked on the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 supplies no standalone pass-through correction and no billing-integrity finding. The billed distance of 17.1 km sits within 0.04 km of the 17.14 km trace figure, so there is no unbilled-kilometre shortfall of the kind that would support driver compensation under POL-RD-04. The rider's consequential heads — the missed bus, the replacement ticket, the lost evening — and the 'wrong building' allegation are not payable under this policy: the remedy is arithmetic against the fare lines, the chat log is empty, and no relocated or substituted dropoff is recorded anywhere in the bundle. The disputed amount is not held; it is refunded in part as above.

Nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and no billing-integrity referral arises.

DRIVER COMPENSATION (POL-RD-04). The billed distance of 17.1 km sits within 0.04 km of the trace figure of 17.14 km, so the unbilled-kilometre shortfall is nowhere near the 1.0 km gate. No compensation is payable and driver_compensation_sgd is null.

NOT PAYABLE. The missed bus, the replacement ticket and the lost evening are consequential losses; no clause in this policy pays them, and POL-RD-02 makes the remedy arithmetic against the fare lines. The 'wrong building' allegation has no support in the bundle: the dropoff is recorded as Woodlands Waterfront Park, the chat log is empty, and no amended or original dropoff is recorded anywhere, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run in the rider's favour. No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across all three artifacts, the timestamps run forward and agree, no exculpatory clause was invoked against a missing or field-less artifact, and the refund is below both SGD 150.00 and charged_total. Confidence is set at 0.95, within the cap of 1.0 carried by EV-GPS-00509.
